d: Short platinum white hair with straight bangs and two long side-locks framing a youthful, adolescent face with wide, bright blue eyes. The build is slender and petite, wearing a black sleeveless bodysuit under a flowing white translucent coat, paired with white thigh-high stockings and white futuristic boots. Signature details include a mechanical white headpiece with blue accents, a large white futuristic weapon, and a massive, segmented white robotic creature with blue glowing lines swirling around the form.
